items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: that Peggy, your wife, was a nurse.

ctx.x: Especially when you're on the road; that can make a big difference.
I guess you were lucky in the other respect, that Peggy, your wife, was a nurse.

Yes. She'd give me the back of the hand, she wouldn't let you feel sorry for yourself. That kept me, as far as the music business is concerned, probably from making the connections that might have lead to further things. It locked me into a certain area and I never have seen to have gotten out of that.
